title.purpose: Toolbar sandbox name and overlay titles; dialog titles 15px, sign-in title 17px.

body.purpose: Default UI text; pane titles at 600.

label.purpose: Field labels, section and chart titles, notes; tabs and buttons at 12.5px.

micro.purpose: State pills, timestamps, table headers, legends, fact labels.

figure.purpose: Key counts and usage totals, tabular.

mono.purpose: Hosts, paths, ids, placeholders, HTTP methods, DNS codes; 13px in the terminal.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Dialogs, toasts, chart tooltips, terminal connection card, newer-events pill, narrow-layout drawers. Nothing else casts a shadow.

motion.name: dur
motion.purpose: Colour and border transitions on controls and rows.

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: Dialogs, toasts, overlay cards, the new-sandbox form.

motion.name: slide-left
motion.purpose: Right panel drawer in narrow layouts.

motion.name: pulse
motion.purpose: State dot during transitional states, in the target state's hue; the live feed dot pulses at 2.4s.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Right panel becomes a fixed drawer.

breakpoints.name: tiny
breakpoints.purpose: Sidebar also becomes a drawer behind a scrim.

breakpoints.name: toolbar-900
breakpoints.purpose: First toolbar buttons collapse to icons.

components.css: .ds-tabs { display:flex; align-items:stretch; gap:2px; height:var(--bar); padding:0 8px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--bg-app); } .ds-tab { position:relative; padding:0 9px; border:0; background:transparent; color:var(--text-muted); font:500 12.5px var(--font-ui); cursor:pointer; transition:color var(--dur) var(--ease); } .ds-tab:hover { color:var(--text-1); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--brass); outline-offset:-4px; border-radius:var(--radius); } .ds-tab[aria-selected='true'] { color:var(--text-hi); } .ds-tab[aria-selected='true']::after { content:''; position:absolute; left:9px; right:9px; bottom:-1px; height:2px; border-radius:2px 2px 0 0; background:var(--brass); }

narrative.overview:
The workspace is a hotel night desk after hours. The desk (iron-proxy) holds the real keys, the rooms (sandboxes) hold only placeholders, and the clerk can see every key that leaves the board. The lobby is a warm charcoal ramp, lit by one brass lamp; everything else is quiet until a state changes.

It is dense but calm: a 28px row module, 11 to 14px type, hairline dividers, and no cards for metrics. The terminal owns the centre and is the darkest surface; sidebar and panel are one step lighter and serve as peripheral vision. Colour carries meaning only. It refuses the cool-slate cloud console with a neon cyan accent and a card grid of metrics.
keyCharacteristics: One warm neutral ramp (n0 to n10), dark-first, no light theme.
One accent, brass, rationed to action, focus, selection and keys.
Four state hues and nothing else: verdigris, night indigo, oxide red, ramp grey.
Credentials drawn as brass key tags with a punched hole.
Flat surfaces; shadows only on things that float.

rules.name: The Brass Budget Rule
rules.body: Brass marks the primary action, focus, selection and keys. It is never decoration, never a chart series, never a state.

rules.name: The Meaning-Only Rule
rules.body: A state hue appears only when that state is true. There is no warning orange: anything that needs attention (time running low, quota full, off-allowlist) is oxide red.

rules.name: The One Ramp Rule
rules.body: Every neutral comes from n0 to n10. Do not introduce a grey that is not on the ramp.

rules.name: The Series Are Not States Rule
rules.body: series-1..4 live inside charts only; state is never encoded with them, and chart lines never borrow state hues.

rules.name: The Mono Means Machine Rule
rules.body: Mono only for the terminal, hosts, paths, ids, HTTP methods and DNS codes. Labels, numbers and prose stay in the UI sans.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every changing number (timers, counts, bytes, quota, axis labels) uses tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Labels are sentence case at their natural weight; there is no uppercase or letter-spaced label style.

rules.name: The 28px Row Rule
rules.body: One row module across sidebar, feed, DNS, tables and timeline; do not invent a second row height.

rules.name: The Fixed Scale Rule
rules.body: Every life bar uses one 8 h scale, so sandboxes compare at a glance; time beyond a sandbox's own cap is drawn as track, not stretched.

rules.name: The Overlays-Only Rule
rules.body: Rows, panes, panels and form surfaces never carry a shadow; selection is an inset brass hairline, not a lift.

rules.name: The Key Tag Silhouette
rules.body: The fob is round on the left and squared on the right (9px 4px 4px 9px; 12px 5px 5px 12px at board size) with a punched hole near the round end. The brand mark is the same tag stood upright. Keep this silhouette for credentials only.

dos: **Do** keep brass to the primary action, focus, selection and keys (The Brass Budget Rule).
**Do** use oxide red for anything that needs attention; there is no warning orange.
**Do** put every list on the 28px row and every bar at 40px.
**Do** draw a credential as the key tag: filled on the Credentials board, outline in the proxy feed, dashed empty hook when revoked.
**Do** use tabular numerals for every live number and mono only for machine strings.
**Do** use the validated series-1..4 palette, in order, for chart categories, with series-other for the remainder.
donts: **Don't** use the cool-slate cloud console look: no cool greys, no neon cyan accent, no card grid of metrics.
**Don't** add a grey outside the n0 to n10 ramp, or a light theme.
**Don't** paint a terminated sandbox's state pill, dot or life bar red; terminated is ramp grey.
**Don't** put shadows on rows, panes or panels; shadows belong to overlays only.
**Don't** label anything twice: a state is its hue plus one word.
**Don't** overlay the terminal with anything except its own connection state.
